value.description: This is a chemfuel-powered mechanitor ship, built for a mechanitor's work. It has stronger mechanoid control and carries more cargo, and it uses more chemfuel. A mechanitor or a mechanoid can pilot it. When a mechanitor is aboard and the player chooses a destination, the ship tries a shuttle landing, visit, or trade first. If the destination cannot be reached that way, the ship hands the cargo to the settlement and then returns empty. If the settlement cannot receive the cargo either, the ship handles the cargo the way a transport pod would, and the ship itself stays with the cargo. When no mechanitor is aboard and only mechanoids are aboard, the ship cannot hand cargo to anyone. If the destination can be reached by shuttle landing, visiting, or trading, the ship goes there as a shuttle. If none of those apply, the delivery fails, and the ship returns to its origin with the mechanoids and the cargo.
